x: John Knifton was 24th in Section A Barnes, Belderson, Beecham and Keown, 6th 7th 30th and 32nd respectively in Section B; Eglington, Cameron, McLennan, Duncan,Wilson and Doubleday between 18 and 62 in Section C; Bushman, East and Logan 14th,15th and 34th in Section D.
Geremew Wolde was always in control, allowing Portsmouth's East to snap at his heels for the first lap before turning on the power over the last couple of miles to win convincingly.

Enter Simon Jones, fighting for a spot in the National line-up and clashing with Newham’s Michael East. Ok, East turned out to be a long way short of his best – but Simon wasn’t to know that as he showed no fear and coolly cruised past all the men ahead.
